name: Plugins
summary: A plugin is a directory that bundles several extension types, such as skills, slash commands, subagents, hooks and MCP servers, so they install, update and toggle as one unit. Plugins are usually distributed through a marketplace file in a git repository.
how: Put skills, agents, hooks and MCP config in one directory
Add a manifest (for example .claude-plugin/plugin.json) with name and version
List it in a marketplace catalog or share the folder
Users install by name and enable per user or project
Plugin skills appear namespaced, such as /plugin:skill
facts: Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw, Hermes Agent
Git-based marketplaces, npm, registries like ClawHub
One-step setup, but every enabled plugin adds context and runs as you
goodFor: Sharing a whole team setup in one install
Versioned releases of skills plus hooks
watchOut: Enabled plugins cost context on every turn
Hooks and MCP servers run with your privileges
